messages: I ran into #p403# again in #m10003000#. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a #o17# flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to #bConstruction Site B2#k, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...

I got Shumi from #m10003000# the lost roll of cash. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she gave me #b30 #t2000003#s#k... She also said I can find other items at #bConstruction Site B2#k... I should go check it out sometime...
name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
